setup.intro: Welcome to Villa Paradiso, where eight weeks of sunshine, challenges and questionable decisions will be broadcast to millions. The host has promised 'a twist every night.'

roles.title: The Fan Favourite
roles.blurb: The audience loves them. The other contestants are suspicious of that.

roles.title: The Strategist
roles.blurb: Says 'I'm not here to make friends' in every confessional.

roles.title: The Late Arrival
roles.blurb: Walked in on day 3 and immediately changed everything.

roles.title: The Confessional Queen
roles.blurb: Nice to everyone's face. Devastating in the diary room.

roles.title: The One Who Is Actually Here For Love
roles.blurb: Nobody knows what to do with this.

roles.title: The Chaos Agent
roles.blurb: Producers' favourite. Has 'accidentally' started three fights.

choice.scene: The host bursts in at 2am: tonight, one of you can read everyone's diary-room confessions. Then everyone finds out who read them.
options: Refuse, and make a big show of refusing

choice.scene: It's the challenge. The team that loses gives up their phones for 24 hours, and your team is losing badly.
options: Give up and work on my tan

choice.scene: A text arrives: 'Tonight, one contestant gets to swap beds with anyone in the villa.'
choice.prompt: What do you do with this power?
options: Keep my bed and look loyal
Sell the swap to the highest bidder

vote_player.scene: The host reveals that one contestant has been secretly running a gossip account about the villa.
vote_player.prompt: Who is running the gossip account?

vote_player.scene: Viewers are voting on who has 'the most dramatic exit if they get dumped from the villa.'
vote_player.prompt: Who would have the most dramatic exit?

vote_player.scene: Producers are planning a spin-off show starring one contestant.
vote_player.prompt: Who gets their own spin-off, and what's it called? (Say it out loud.)

options: Walks out of the diary room

{target} wins the final challenge: £10,000, or a surprise mystery envelope.

titles: Most Likely to Cry in a Confessional
recap.epilogue: The season wrapped. The reunion episode is going to be a disaster.
